FORM.SUMMARY: Once you have added a competition, you can add it to the season configuration so that it can be used in the season.

HELPERS.TYPE: Select the type of competition. League competitions are round-robin style, while cup competitions are knockout style.

ADD_COMPETITION.ERROR: There was an error adding the competition. Please try again.

DELETE_COMPETITION.ERROR: There was an error deleting the competition. Please try again.
